# onetsolutions_vpc (Data Source)

Looks up a VPC of a project by `id` or by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_vpc" "backend" {
  name = "backend"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID of the VPC. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `name` (String) The name of the VPC. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `cidr_block` (String) The private IPv4 range of the VPC in CIDR notation.
- `created` (String) When the VPC was created (RFC 3339).
